purpose: Future fail-closed SPDX 2.3 normalization and validation fixtures; no release SBOM is generated in the inventory repair stage.

cases.mutation: Remove mandatory creationInfo.created from an otherwise valid SPDX 2.3 JSON document.
Set creationInfo.created from the runner wall clock instead of the accepted build epoch.
Use a non-UTC or non-RFC3339 timestamp in creationInfo.created.
Generate documentNamespace with a random UUID or another volatile value for identical build evidence.
Reuse the same documentNamespace for a different image digest or exact source/build-definition identity.
Provide an SPDX 2.3 JSON document that fails the pinned official schema before publication.
